title: TUI restoration and dashboard accent selector
scope: Restore black-orange terminal visual language: #0a0a0a background, #141414 panels, #fab283 primary accent, Cascadia Mono typography.
Add a dashboard accent selector with orange as the migration/default value and blue/purple preview variants.
Apply the persisted accent to the existing hotkey popup (the popup inherits the dashboard preference) and persist it across dashboard/application restart.
Keep widget text/font setting independent from dashboard accent selection.
preserve: Existing config keys, unknown-key round trips, APIs, hotkey fallback behavior, OCR guards, and profile handling.
Existing widget text setting semantics and all non-Phase-1 dashboard tools.
implementation_steps: Map the approved mock to the existing ui.html and Rust dashboard bridge without replacing stable APIs.
Add a normalized accent preference with orange migration default and blue/purple values.
Apply accent tokens to title, controls, focus, charts, and popup while leaving widget text configuration separate.
Persist the preference through the normal config path and reload it on fresh process startup.
Add focused Rust/JS regression coverage, including real WebView2 dashboard, narrow layout, migration, restart, popup, and widget-text cases.

automated.case: Run core defaults/config migration test with a config missing dashboard_accent; expect orange and unchanged unrelated keys
automated.evidence: Real dashboard_ui WebView2 legacy fixture has no accent and starts at #fab283. Unknown accent_test_sentinel stays keep. cu-core 64 checks passed in Luna runs.

automated.case: In dashboard_ui WebView2 script select blue then purple; expect root accent token changes and config dashboard_accent only changes for this setting
automated.evidence: Independent temporary WebView2 --e2e fixture dispatched blue then purple change. Computed CSS changed immediately to #8bb8ff then #c7a0ff, both preferences persisted, widget_theme=light and sentinel unchanged.

automated.case: Save purple, close/relaunch dashboard, then launch --quick-tool popup; expect the popup to inherit purple title/control accent values
automated.evidence: dashboard_process_end_to_end passed with normal dashboard relaunch and actual --quick-tool grammar using piped fixture input, compact mode, hidden picker, and purple inherited.

automated.case: Set widget_label/widget_font, change accent, reload config; expect widget_label/widget_font byte-semantic values unchanged
automated.evidence: dashboard_ui asserts widget_theme light, widget_label short and widget_font 135 with unknown config preserved across restart. Independently ran widget parity (2 passed) and app widget canvas tests (3 passed).

automated.case: Run dashboard_ui real WebView2 at 520px and 420px fit and inspect computed tokens; expect no JS errors and readable narrow layout
automated.evidence: dashboard_ui WebView2 checks 520/420 fitted windows and title bounds passed final rerun. Diff check passed.

real_ui.case: Launch dashboard, invoke auto-fit/narrow 520px window, and visually check black #0a0a0a, panel #141414, Cascadia Mono, and orange #fab283
real_ui.evidence: Visible native WebView2 dashboard at 430×520 showed orange on black, Cascadia Mono, Vietnamese labels, and full picker/button row after fixing clipped label.

real_ui.case: Change accent in dashboard, close it, open/reopen the hotkey popup, and visually check inherited title/control accent
real_ui.evidence: Changed Cam to Tím from the visible dashboard via keyboard. Opened real --quick-tool grammar in the same isolated config and observed purple title, focus ring and action, Grammar input and paste fallback with picker hidden.

real_ui.case: Restart dashboard after changing accent and widget text; expect selected accent restored while widget text remains the chosen value
real_ui.evidence: Closed/reopened visible dashboard, observed Tím selected, then opened widget appearance and observed Chữ tối. Isolated config dashboard_accent=purple, widget_theme=light, review_sentinel=unchanged.
